website.description: DailyDuty is a XivLauncher/Dalamud Plugin for automatically tracking and managing the various daily and weekly tasks that are available for completion in Final Fantasy 14
website.readmeExcerpt: # DailyDuty [![Download count](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https://qzysathwfhebdai6xgauhz4q7m0mzmrf.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/DailyDuty)](https://github.com/MidoriKami/DailyDuty) DailyDuty is a XivLauncher/Dalamud plugin. DailyDuty allows you to easily and automatically track various daily and weekly tasks. DailyDuty is designed for people that need _**constant reminders**_ to do things or else they will entirely forget to do them. The goal of this plugin is to allow you to more easily and more passively complete tasks that reward weekly or daily bonuses. DailyDuty will **not** track anything to do with Retainers or Free Companies, for that use `Accountant` by `Ottermandias` ## Configuration Window You can open the configuration window with the chat command `/dd` or `/dailyduty` This window has all the available configuration options for each module within DailyDuty ## Status Display Each module can show you its current status at a glance to see basic information. ## Data Display You can also see the current state of all the data that is being tracked via the data tab. ## Module Configuration Modes are enabled and configured independently from each other and can be configured from the gear button near the module name in the main window. All modules have Notification Settings, but not all modules will have settings for the module itself. ## Todo Panel The primary way to track what tasks are still outstanding is via the Todo Panels, you can have several panels each configured to track a different set of modules, or even the same modules. Hovering over an entry in the Todo Panel will show a tooltip elaborating on the modules specific status, and some modules will have a click interaction that will take you to the relevent location to do that task. Note: Not all modules have tooltips, and not all modules have click interactions. ## Chat Notifications DailyDuty also uses chat messages to notify you of tasks that are able to be completed. You will not see notifications for tasks that aren't yet available to be completed, such as Fashion Report, until there is something that you the user are able to do. You will not see notifications for tasks that are "Complete", you can use `/dd status` to view the status of the various modules. DailyDuty also includes clickable chat links that have an associated action they will do once clicked on. Modules that have clickable links will describe what that modules links will do, and allow you to enable or disable the link. **All chat messages can only been seen by you, Dalamud Plugins are client side only** (Example notifications, this is not a complete list) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9083275/172264986-6a4a5528-9e65-4d30-bd84-288e36ce26da.png)
